text_version.source: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali, docweb 9870832
text_version.note: Urgent measure (provvedimento n. 112 of 30 March 2023) adopted by the President under Art. 5(8) of Garante Regulation 1/2000, subject to ratification.

summary.short: Urgent order of Italy's data protection authority imposing on OpenAI an immediate temporary limitation on processing personal data of people in Italy through ChatGPT, and requiring OpenAI to report its remedial measures within 20 days.
summary.long: Acting under GDPR Article 58(2)(f), the Garante found that ChatGPT provided no information notice to users or data subjects, lacked a legal basis for collecting and processing personal data to train its algorithms, processed inaccurate data, and had no age verification although OpenAI's terms reserve the service to users aged 13 or older. It considered these breaches of GDPR Articles 5, 6, 8, 13 and 25. It ordered, with immediate effect from receipt, a provisional limitation of the processing of personal data of data subjects established in Italy, pending its investigation. OpenAI was asked to report within 20 days the measures taken and any justification. Non-compliance is subject to the criminal penalty in Article 170 of the Italian Privacy Code and to GDPR Article 83(5)(e) administrative fines. The order can be appealed to the ordinary courts within 30 days, or 60 for residents abroad.

territorial_scope.description: Addressed to OpenAI L.L.C. (United States); covers personal data of data subjects established in Italy.

thresholds.note: The only number, age 13, comes from OpenAI's own terms, so it is not coded (codebook 3.4). The 20- and 30-day limits are coded as events.

definitions.note: An individual order; no defined terms.

notes: The later order of 11 April 2023 setting conditions for lifting the limitation is a separate instrument (it-garante-2023-chatgpt-conditions); it is not referenced in this text, so it is not recorded as a relation here (codebook 3.8).
